FAQ

For packaging importers and distributors FAQ

Can coated paper and finished food-paper products be reviewed in one inquiry?

Yes. Send the target portfolio and identify each product's customer channel, specification, quantity, packing and evidence needs.

Is MOQ fixed across the range?

No. For coated base paper MOQ generally starts at 5 tonnes; for existing food-paper lines it is confirmed by product, specification and order requirements. Lead time depends on the order quantity and production schedule. It is confirmed in the written quotation rather than published as a fixed number of days.

Can the supplier identity be kept confidential?

Public product pages do not disclose the upstream supplier. Document review is handled within the buyer qualification process.
